description: Human-approved #768 prerequisite: allow multiple ChannelConfig records for one provider. Audit/refactor provider-singleton get_by_provider/get_any_by_provider/upsert, routing, connector lifecycle, outbound selection and BO surfaces to require an explicit connector or return a structured ambiguity instead of choosing arbitrary config. Tests first: two same-provider configs, stable explicit selection, ambiguous legacy resolution, SMTP/disk/data-source compatibility and migration rollback; preserve legacy sole-provider behavior. Read docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md before settings/token edits, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md. Reuse ChannelConfig/Channels APIs; do not duplicate Actions. Run focused tests and mix q; no commit/push implied.

comments.text: Human chose expanding same-provider ChannelConfig multiplicity inside #768. Added unconsumed 20260922000004 drop-unique/provider-index migration with safe rollback guard; explicit resolve_by_provider(provider, config_id) and Bridge fetch_channel_config(provider, config_id), provider-only reads/updates fail closed on ambiguous stored configs (including disabled), get_by_channel_id prevents cross-config reuse of identical external room IDs. Channel BO posts now selects matching configured room when unique and retains singleton fallback. Identity and merge tests prove same opaque author ID on two Slack configs remains distinct. Focused 235 tests/2 properties earlier, then 135 tests/2 properties plus BO channels 64 tests pass; mix q passes. Still in progress: provider-only SMTP/data-source/runtime/BO selection audit and duplicate provider write race; do not close. No commit/push.

Further audit: BO retrieval picker requires explicit connector choice for >1 config; provider default controls and team browsing follow chosen config. ChannelConfig.get_by_channel_id handles same external room ID across configs and falls back to singleton only when safe. SMTP outbound now rejects :ambiguous_connector before using fallback Mailer settings (regression 34 SMTP tests pass). No commit/push.

Webhook explicit selection progress: JidoChatBridge subscription target URL now carries numeric config ID; ChannelsController parses URL ID rather than payload, Channels.Api forwards it, CommunicationBridge.handle_webhook/3 selects enabled provider-matching config before invoking adapter webhook validation; provider-only legacy path fails closed for ambiguous live configs. Scoped URL, controller, API, bridge regressions added. Focused combined run 348 tests had one outdated expected URL; updated; mix q passes. Remaining: integration exercise provider webhook signature/path verification and data-source watcher multi-config selection. No commit/push.

Multi-config data-source webhook path now selects exact enabled provider config through DataSourceBridge.handle_webhook/3; BO ingestion watch creation and Engine renewal emit connector-scoped URLs. New unconsumed 00008 migrates watch-channel uniqueness from provider/channel_id to config/provider/channel_id (safe down guard); JidoConnectBridge includes config_id in watch lookup, Engine rejects ambiguous unscoped IDs. 269 core data-source tests+property, then 435 BO/ingestion/data-source tests+property pass; mix q passes. Still open pending lifecycle/routing audit and migration validation.

Further provider-only audit: IdentityResolver now carries its validated ingress channel_config_id into Channels fetch_profile/open_dm_channel events; Channels.Api resolves exact enabled provider-matching connector and uses its credentials/bot identity. Legacy unscoped callers require unambiguous config for profile; selected ID rejects mismatches. API and resolver suites 107 tests pass; combined API/resolver/data-source BO 171 tests pass; mix q passes. Still assess provider-only outbound/send_typing paths and concurrent archive/watch creation before closing/committing. No push.

Expanded outbound multi-connector audit: Outgoing now carries trusted Incoming.routing_context (not metadata), Channels.Api.deliver_outgoing resolves exact provider-matching connector credentials, provider-only ambiguous delivery fails closed. Agent.Status carries same context into status upserts; API selects exact connector for updates. Identity profile/DM scope and webhook scope already done. Focused agent/API/status 139 tests pass after one isolated timing-sensitive existing status test retry; mix q passes. Remaining: inspect other provider-only operations and integrated multi-connector message transport before closing/committing.

Remaining BO gap from provider-only audit: NotificationImapLive and NotificationSmtpLive use get_any_by_provider and IMAP upsert_by_provider, so with multiple live same-provider configs the special email settings pages display blank/default instead of a selected connector (save fails closed). Generic ChannelsLive retrieval picker already supports multiple. Need explicit email-page connector selection or route it to existing picker before claiming full multi-connector BO support. No silent mutation observed; leave bead open.

Human approved dedicated IMAP/SMTP pages reusing same connector-settings bar as Mattermost/Telegram, not a separate select. /extract report found inline ChannelsLive config card header/actions and analogous ProviderLive header, no existing full reusable component/story; human approved extraction row 1. Created DesignSystem.ChannelConnectorCard (parent-owned action slot and optional selection), Storybook card story and 2 component ExUnit tests. Original LiveViews remain unchanged per /extract; replacement wiring awaits separate /replace human gate. mix q clean; story compiles via mix run --no-start, but Storybook runtime smoke blocked because dev DB has not applied archived_at migration (test DB is migrated). No DB migration run on populated dev database; no commit/push.

Extraction phase includes Storybook URL registry entry in test/e2e/support/story-urls.json. Component ExUnit 2 tests pass; story compiles with mix run --no-start; latest mix q passes. Follow-on design-migrate/token review and separate replace/wiring approval needed for Mattermost + dedicated IMAP/SMTP screens. Do not call extracted card wired yet.

Human approved /replace row 1: generic ChannelsLive connector cards (Mattermost, Telegram, other providers) now use DesignSystem.ChannelConnectorCard, preserving ingress-status, toggle, edit, test and archive button IDs/events; 66 ChannelsLive tests and 2 component tests pass, mix q passes, git diff --check clean. A pre-existing ChannelsLive test assumed outbound without configured connector; fixed fixture by inserting the required sole connector without weakening assertion. Rows 2 (DataSourceProviderLive custom cards) and 3 (dedicated IMAP/SMTP settings) not wired yet. Email multi-account decision needed: current EmailBridge and SmtpSender depend on provider-only singleton SMTP and IMAP runtime behavior. No commit/push.

Human decision: explicit administrator-designated SMTP default for notifications lacking a connector ID; connector-bound replies use their bound account. Do not arbitrarily pick a same-provider connector. Implement a durable explicit default and fail-closed invariant for multiple accounts, plus account-specific IMAP/SMTP pages. Generic ChannelsLive card replacement validated (66 tests and mix q); no commit/push.

SMTP/IMAP follow-up: explicit SMTP notification default in ChannelConfig (transaction/advisory lock + unique partial index migration 20260922000009), SmtpSender unscoped notification selection and explicit connector delivery, dedicated IMAP/SMTP settings use connector bars and require selection for multi-account edits; IMAP form binds inbox to enabled SMTP for replies. EmailBridge derives SMTP binding from trusted IMAP routing connector and uses bound account for delivery and generated Message-ID domain; unbound legacy inbox only uses sole SMTP, disabled/archived binding fails closed. Reused existing ChannelConfig.resolve_by_provider, changeset and EmailBridge/SmtpSender instead of new Action/tool; UI selection helper local-only (BO view state, no independent executable domain operation). Focused email/BO groups 170+ tests passing, mix q passes; no new-feature E2E authored pending UX approval. Remaining: data-source connector card extension/replacement gate, deeper multi-connector integration audit and coverage, migration rollback, final validation. No commit/push.

Scope correction from human (2026-09-26): shared connector-bar UI is for communication channels only. Do NOT extend or replace DataSources.ProviderLive cards under this UI work. ChannelsLive route is /channels/retrieval/:provider; data-source routes use a separate ProviderLive. Existing #768 data-source watch/archive backend work remains separate from this UI clarification.

Communications-only UI scope confirmed; no DataSources.ProviderLive card replacement. Follow-up regression exposed archive-default takeover: fixed ChannelConfig.resolve_notification_smtp to honor an explicitly designated default even if archived/disabled instead of promoting remaining connector; SmtpSender propagates missing-default error. New archive-default regression + email/BO focused 171 tests pass; mix q and git diff --check pass. No commit/push. Remaining prerequisites: broader API/bridge and notification integration audit, coverage/human UX E2E approval and migration handling.

Coordination: zaq-emb.21.1 claimed for PR799 CI 31-failure repair. This session owns lib/zaq/channels/api.ex plus test/zaq/channels/{api_test,email_html_delivery_test}.exs and test/zaq/engine/notifications/{notification_test,email_threading_test,outbound_threading_regression_test}.exs. Other agents: please do not edit those paths or independently repair PR799 delivery failures; coordinate via zaq-emb.21.1 before touching. Will keep changes isolated to PR799 branch; no push without authorization.

Continuation under #768: reserved coherent data-source watch-scoping and archive lifecycle slice on a new stacked branch based on PR #800; .21 connector-scoped watch uniqueness/callback/lookup comes first, .22 archive teardown depends on it. Reuse ChannelConfig.resolve_by_provider/2, WebhookUrl.build/3, DataSources watch APIs and Channels/Engine NodeRouter events; extend rather than duplicate operations. No Action/tool exposure: watch create/renew/unwatch remain service operations, not agent tools. Test fixtures already in preserved deferred stash will be reviewed against current head before restoring; old stash also contains superseded email/executor diffs and must not be applied wholesale. Communication connector-card UI scope unchanged; data-source ProviderLive existing delete/archive behavior only. New-feature E2E stays blocked on zaq-emb.12 human UX approval.
